name: Outdoor Adventure
tagline: Trails, lakes and campfires for the adventurous profile.
description: Show the outdoorsy side of your dating profile: summits, kayaks, campfires, canyons and trail runs. Active, sunlit and full of life, with your face clearly visible in every shot so matches can see who they're going on that hike with.
